messages:
priya: quick heads-up, nightly_recon surfaced a higher-than-normal late-arrival rate for marketplace events (Orion Hardware & Nebula). ~1.2% of events in the last 48h arrived >24h late. billing asked for a playbook to limit credits.

maria: ouch. do we have a pattern? same region / same proxy? any 5xxs logged?

alex: checked proxy logs: multiple upstream 502/504s between 03:05-04:10 UTC on both days hitting marketplace-proxy-prod. spike correlates with partner fanout rate increase. attached sample error lines: ```
[2026-03-19T03:12:04Z] marketplace-proxy ERROR downstream 502 id=evt_01H9M6 abc
[2026-03-19T03:14:32Z] marketplace-proxy ERROR downstream 504 id=evt_01H9M72 def
```

samir: could be partner retry storms causing backpressure. hardware partners often retry aggressively with no jitter. we should publish recommended retry policy in the partner spec (exponential backoff, jitter, max-retries=5).

jordan: from billing ops: we need deterministic reason codes on reconciliation exports so finance can act. propose: LOST, DUPLICATE, LATE_ARRIVAL, SKU_MISMATCH, OUT_OF_WINDOW. can we make those canonical across partners?

carla: yes please. sales wants a template customer message for cases where we don't issue credits because the partner is at fault (e.g., events >72h and partner didn't provide ack logs). I'll draft one once codes are final.

priya: action items I'm taking: 1) send partners a "connectivity & retry" addendum w/ sample HTTP acks and the X-RW-EVENT-ID header requirement, 2) request S3 ack logs for last 7 days.

alex: infra actions: 1) add idempotency header check and dedupe in fanout (x-rw-idempotency-key) 2) emit distributed spans at fanout + ingest (trace join on event_id) 3) short-term: increase proxy pool and tune timeouts to reduce 5xx under burst. ETA: spans + dedupe in 5 days, infra tuning by EOD tomorrow.

maria: technical note: some partner payloads include plan_sku that doesn't map to our entitlement table; that's producing false mismatches flagged as SKU_MISMATCH. we need a SKU mapping table and a validation webhook to reject bad SKUs early.

jordan: reconciliation infra: I'll extend nightly_recon to accept partner ACKS (S3 path) and produce a CSV with columns: event_id, customer_id, partner_ack_ts, ingest_ts, delta_seconds, reason_code. will also surface top 25 customers by USD impact. ETA: 48hrs for MVP.

billing-bot: automated-report: nightly_recon job finished. summary: total_events=1,042,178; late_arrivals=12,508 (1.2%); flagged=624 (high-impact). report: https://redwood.prod/recon/1980123456

priya: thanks @billing-bot. Maria / Alex, can you triage the flagged high-impact rows for Nebula + Orion today? I'll start partner outreach.

maria: taking Nebula cluster. will open a partner escalation and include example event payloads + traced spans.

alex: taking Orion infra regressions. I'll post an infra incident if we see recurring 5xxs after tuning.

carla: I'll prepare stakeholder comms and hold a 1:1 with finance to review the CSV format. Also drafting the customer-facing message template.

priya: plan for longer term: (A) require signed envelope (HMAC x-rw-sig) on partner pushes, (B) offer a pull-based endpoint for partners who prefer batch uploads (S3+signed-manifest), (C) standardize reason codes and a joint SLA for entitlements.

jordan: agree. and let's codify an acceptance window (e.g., auto-accept events <=72h; events 72h-7d require partner proof; >7d auto-reject pending special approvals).

maria: good. we'll reconvene in #partnerships after partners send ack logs. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
